title: Le Bomb
description: A Minecraft modpack which includes a new variety of mobs, boss mobs,  blocks, and difficulty scaling
body:
Simply a challenging, yet fun modpack for minecraft. No changes to the gameplay, simply made into a harder and more replay friendly game. With two difficulty spikes following the progression line of entering the nether, and defeating the ender dragon, even the end game is challenging

DEPENDENT ON "BORN IN CHAOS" by Mongoose_artist
